# Ukrinform

> > Ukraine's multimedia platform for objective information

Ukrinform is Ukraine's national news agency providing comprehensive coverage of the Russia-Ukraine war, including daily updates on military operations, civilian casualties, diplomatic developments, and domestic policy. The agency reports on key figures like President Volodymyr Zelensky and covers critical regions including Kherson, Donetsk, and Crimea.

## Key Topics

- Russia-Ukraine War
- Civilian casualties
- Russian attacks and strikes
- Kherson region
- Donetsk region
- Volodymyr Zelensky
- Drone attacks
- Artillery shelling
- Energy infrastructure
- Power outages
- Ukrainian POWs
- Evacuation operations
- Defense Intelligence of Ukraine
- Civilian infrastructure damage
- International diplomacy

- [Russians execute 337 Ukrainian POWs – Lubinets](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4097612-russians-execute-337-ukrainian-pows-lubinets.html): Ombudsman Lubinets: Russia executed 337 Ukrainian POWs by end of 2025
